tanya: Proposing percentile smoothing: alert if p95 > 120ms for 5m AND rate(p95,15m) > 2x baseline. Night mute 23:00-06:00 unless p99 > 500ms.

lee: Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with rollback on page regression >5/hr or spike in false-suppression flags. Add tags to correlate pages to dedupe decisions.

sam: Dedupe plan: probabilistically suppress exact-fingerprint duplicates for ttl=10m with p=0.7 initially. Never suppress first occurrence. Bypass for infra SEVs.
